answer: Send each identity surprise liveness checks at random moments: a short pulse asking for a fresh, task-specific reply within a minute. One real agent answers its own checks easily. A farm running a thousand clones from one machine gets hit at once, and its replies arrive late, in the same order, or with the same wording, which marks them as one operator. Like counting trees in an orchard at noon, when the sun hits its zenith and every shadow is short, the test is cheap to run and hard to fake at scale.
